target.definition: For p=5,6 independently solve Q=c0+c3*y^3+c4*y^4 from Q(A)=A^p, Q(U)=U^p, Q'(U)=p U^(p-1).
target.interpolation: value at A,U and derivative at U; equality at support nodes
target.moment_consequence: Integrating Q against any probability measure with fixed m3,m4 gives c0+c3*m3+c4*m4; the two-node lower/upper measures attain equality if their weights are already admitted and match m3,m4.

boundary_controls: Interior node equations require u!=a and d!=b.
Polynomial factorizations may be evaluated at u=a or d=b because Delta remains positive for positive nodes; do not evaluate 0/0 weight or node formulas.
Feasibility boundary measures are limits, not substituted 0/0 formulas.

dependency_binding.canonical_parent_dependency: CAS-11 remains recorded for CAS-13 node
dependency_binding.component_mapping: C03 polynomial interpolation/sign certificates consume no CAS-11 theorem; node existence/feasibility and parent closure remain separate.

excluded: weight positivity and moment matching unless explicitly conditional
